ContentStudio

ContentStudio is a social media management platform for publishing, workspace collaboration, analytics, and social inbox workflows.

72 actionsAPI key

Connect ContentStudio

What your bot can do in ContentStudio

Looks up

  • Get AI InsightsGenerate AI analytics insights for one connected Facebook, GMB, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, or YouTube account using one of…
  • Get Analytics SummaryReturn current-versus-previous summary KPIs for one connected Facebook, GMB, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, Twitter, or YouTube…
  • Get Audience DemographicsReturn a supported Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, or YouTube audience demographics report through one of eight fixed ContentStudio routes.
  • Get Audience Growth AnalyticsReturn audience, follower, or subscriber growth for one connected social account through an explicit platform, report, and granularity…
  • Get Content AnalyticsGet analytics for one platform-native Facebook, GMB, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, TikTok, Twitter, or YouTube content item.
  • Get Current UserReturn the active ContentStudio user associated with the connected API key.
  • Get Engagement AnalyticsReturn active-user, impression, engagement, action, page-view, view, or watch-time analytics from one of 21 fixed ContentStudio routes.
  • Get GMB Activity AnalyticsReturn Google Business Profile search-keyword, review, or media-activity analytics from one of exactly three documented routes.
  • Get Inbox ContactGet the contact profile associated with a ContentStudio Social Inbox element.
  • Get Media Performance AnalyticsReturn Facebook reel/video, Instagram hashtag/story/reel, or LinkedIn hashtag performance through one of six fixed ContentStudio routes.

  • Get Publishing AnalyticsReturn publishing behavior, posting cadence, pin rollups, YouTube discovery or sharing, or performance-schedule analytics from one of 12…
  • Get Twitter Credits UsedReturn Twitter/X API credits consumed by one connected account over a date range.
  • List Approval WorkflowsList published approval workflows available in a ContentStudio workspace.
  • List CampaignsList or search campaigns in a ContentStudio workspace and return campaign IDs for post assignment.
  • List Connection PlatformsList every social platform supported by ContentStudio account connection and identify whether each uses OAuth, credentials, or a manual…
  • List Content CategoriesList or search content categories in a ContentStudio workspace and return category IDs usable when targeting posts.
  • List Facebook Text BackgroundsList every Facebook colored-text background preset ID usable in facebook_options on plain-text posts.
  • List Inbox Conversation ContentList messages, internal notes, or bookmarked messages for one ContentStudio Social Inbox conversation.
  • List Inbox Post CommentsList public Social Inbox comment threads for a platform post reference.
  • List Inbox TagsList all Social Inbox tags in a ContentStudio workspace.
  • List LabelsList or search labels in a ContentStudio workspace.
  • List MediaList and filter media-library assets in a ContentStudio workspace.
  • List Post CommentsList collaboration comments and internal notes on a ContentStudio post.
  • List PostsList ContentStudio workspace posts using status, date, approval, label, campaign, content-category, creator, and comment-state filters.
  • List Ranked Content AnalyticsList one offset-paginated page of top, least-performing, sorted, or pin-performance content analytics for one connected account.
  • List Social AccountsList connected social accounts in a ContentStudio workspace.
  • List Team MembersList or search team members in a ContentStudio workspace and return user and membership IDs, roles, memberships, and available permissions.
  • List WorkspacesList workspaces accessible to the connected account and return workspace IDs for workspace-scoped tools.

Takes action

  • Add Facebook Group AccountAdd a Facebook Group to a ContentStudio workspace through the manual connection flow.
  • Add Inbox NoteCreate an internal note on a ContentStudio Social Inbox conversation, optionally mentioning workspace users.
  • Add Post CommentAdd a collaboration comment to a ContentStudio post, optionally mentioning workspace users.
  • Add Post NoteAdd an internal note to a ContentStudio post.
  • Bulk Set Inbox Elements ArchivedArchive or unarchive 1-100 ContentStudio Social Inbox elements in one provider batch.
  • Bulk Set Inbox Elements StatusSet the workflow status of 1-100 ContentStudio Social Inbox elements to done or pending in one provider batch.
  • Connect Bluesky AccountConnect a Bluesky profile directly to a ContentStudio workspace using its handle and a Bluesky app password.
  • Create CampaignCreate a named, color-coded campaign in a ContentStudio workspace.
  • Create Inbox TagCreate a named, color-coded Social Inbox tag in a ContentStudio workspace.
  • Create LabelCreate a named, color-coded label in a ContentStudio workspace.
Show 32 more
  • Create PostCreate a draft, queued, content-category, or scheduled ContentStudio post with complete media, platform publishing, first-comment, label,…
  • Create WorkspaceCreate a ContentStudio workspace with its required name, logo URL, and timezone.
  • Delete CampaignPermanently delete a campaign from a ContentStudio workspace.
  • Delete Inbox CommentPermanently delete one public ContentStudio Social Inbox comment from its connected social platform.
  • Delete Inbox MessageSoft-delete one ContentStudio Social Inbox message from its connected platform account.
  • Delete Inbox Review ReplyPermanently delete the business reply from one ContentStudio Social Inbox review.
  • Delete Inbox TagsPermanently delete one or more ContentStudio Social Inbox tags by ID.
  • Delete LabelPermanently delete a label from a ContentStudio workspace.
  • Delete PostPermanently delete a ContentStudio post and optionally attempt deletion from selected or all social accounts where it was published.
  • Delete WorkspacePermanently delete a workspace and its workspace-scoped state.
  • Invite Team MemberInvite a team or client member to a ContentStudio workspace with a role and the provider's exact structured permission map.
  • Mark Inbox Element ReadMark one ContentStudio Social Inbox element as read.
  • Merge Inbox TagsIrreversibly replace at least two ContentStudio Social Inbox source tags with one tag using the requested name and color.
  • Remove Social AccountDisconnect a social account from a ContentStudio workspace.
  • Remove Team MemberPermanently remove a member from a ContentStudio workspace.
  • Reply To Inbox ReviewPublish a public business reply to a ContentStudio Social Inbox review, replacing its existing reply when one exists.
  • Review Post ApprovalApprove or reject a ContentStudio post that is under review, optionally recording a review comment.
  • Send Inbox CommentPublish a public comment or reply on a ContentStudio Social Inbox post.
  • Send Inbox MessageSend a Facebook or Instagram direct message through ContentStudio Social Inbox, optionally with one image or video attachment.
  • Send Inbox Private ReplySend a Facebook private reply from a ContentStudio Social Inbox post as a private message, optionally with an attachment.
  • Set Inbox Comment HiddenHide or unhide one ContentStudio Social Inbox comment.
  • Set Inbox Comment LikedLike or unlike one ContentStudio Social Inbox comment.
  • Set Inbox Message BookmarkedBookmark or unbookmark one ContentStudio Social Inbox message.
  • Update CampaignUpdate a campaign's name or color.
  • Update Inbox ContactPartially update the name, email, phone, or company of the contact associated with a ContentStudio Social Inbox element.
  • Update Inbox Element TagsAdd one or more tags to a ContentStudio Inbox element or remove one tag from it.
  • Update Inbox TagUpdate a ContentStudio Social Inbox tag's name or color.
  • Update LabelUpdate a label's name or color.
  • Update PostFully replace an unpublished post's content, accounts, scheduling, platform options, labels, campaign, and approval configuration.
  • Update Team MemberReplace a workspace member's role and complete permission map, and optionally replace their team or client membership class.
  • Update WorkspaceUpdate selected settings of an existing workspace.
  • Upload MediaUpload one media file or import one public media URL into a ContentStudio workspace media library.
